title: Identification of biomarkers for the diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus with metabolic associated fatty liver disease by bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation.
summary: Integrated transcriptomic analysis and machine-learning feature selection prioritized T2DM-associated fatty-liver biomarkers, followed by expression checks in an independent/in-house cohort; findings are limited to the tested cohorts.
ai_technology: Machine-learning feature selection on integrated transcriptomic data prioritized biomarkers, followed by gene-expression validation in an independent/in-house cohort.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Integrated transcriptomic analysis and machine-learning feature selection prioritized T2DM-associated fatty-liver biomarkers, followed by expression checks in an independent/in-house cohort; findings are limited to the tested cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Biomarker expression checks in the studied cohorts do not establish causality, prospective diagnostic performance or clinical utility.
